name: Kasuga Haruna
source:
A bright and cheerful mood maker.
A stubborn girl who is loyal and kind, and will not change her mind once she has made a decision.

Her family owns a souvenir shop in the center of the hot spring town, and has been the face of the hot spring town for generations.
Hina also has a wide circle of friends, and remembers the faces of most of the locals.
